title: The 32K question
intro: Llama 3 70B stores ~320 KB of K/V per token. A user pastes a 32K-token document.
prompt: How much KV-cache memory does that single 32K-token request consume (GB)?

live.label: Users that size would fit in the 180 GB pool

debrief:
32,000 tokens × 320 KB ≈ **10.2 GB — for one request**. The 180 GB pool (4×80 GB minus 140 GB of weights) serves ~18 such users if none of it is wasted; a naive allocator that only keeps 20–40% useful serves 2–3. At 128K context one request is ~40 GB.
